packages.title: Re-confirm the «Crear el proyecto» question fixes (no code change)
brief: Round 3 of run 2026-10-18-commands (b2). This package changes no code. Round 2's reviewer did check P148 and wrote both findings `fixed` in .claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-18-commands/verify-b2-r2-A.md, but in a heading format («### UX-909 · S2 · fixed») that the workflow didn't read, so it reported them as not checked. This package only re-confirms them so their status is recorded. It isn't a new attempt at UX-909.

UX-909 (S2): P148 made `_undecided` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:2423-2440) return `({names, lists})`, and `_draftReady` (:2442-2451) holds back a draft with no `newProject` whose `task.listId` is in `lists`. `_save` (:2852-2853) and `build` (:3420-3421) use the same record. Confirm that this is still in the tree, and that App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart:3439 and :4250-4346 pass.

UX-1219 (S1): P148 added `selectedNone` (default true) to `chooseTaskList` (App/lib/widgets/task_list_picker.dart:26-35, row at :59), and `ProjectChoices`' «Otro proyecto…» passes `selectedNone: false` (App/lib/widgets/capture_command_cards.dart:293-298). Confirm that this is still in the tree, and that App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart:4349-4404 passes.

Don't touch anything. If a check above doesn't hold (code gone, or a test failing), stop and say so in your notes rather than re-fixing: the organizer then re-plans it. Reviewer: write each finding's status as a table row (| ID | status | evidence |), as in verify-b2-r1-A.md.
acceptance: ES: a result with one draft «Repasar el tema 3» (listId 'fyq', no newProject) and a `project` command «Química» whose existing_list_id is 'fyq' («Física y Química»): the confirming button is disabled and reads «Revisa los detalles»; a tap saves nothing. After «Crear «Química»» or «Física y Química» it is enabled (App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart:3439 and :4250-4346 pass).

ES: on that question card, «Otro proyecto…» opens the project sheet with no row highlighted; tapping «Sin proyecto» clears the question and the task saves with no project. From a task's project chip with no project, «Sin proyecto» is still shown chosen (App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart:4349-4404 passes).
deviceChecks: Already recorded in round 2 (P148): with the real model, «Crea el proyecto Química y apunta repasar el tema 3 en él» beside «Física y Química» waits for a chip.

packages.title: Back from the reopened «Confirma tu correo» plays the usual transition; re-confirm P149
brief: Round 3 of run 2026-10-18-commands (b2). P149 is in the tree and its reviewer wrote all four of its findings `fixed` (verify-b2-r2-D.md), with one polish regression, R2D-1, now UX-1220. Line numbers are from the current working tree; search if they have moved.

UX-1220 (S1, regression R2D-1 from P149), closing the reopened screen plays a shorter Back animation: P149 added `_ShownAtOnce` (App/lib/screens/login_screen.dart:23-33), a MaterialPageRoute subclass that overrides `transitionDuration => Duration.zero` (:28-29) and also `reverseTransitionDuration => const Duration(milliseconds: 300)` (:31-32). The brief asked that closing keep the usual reverse transition. `MaterialRouteTransitionMixin` (Flutter packages/flutter/lib/src/material/page.dart:96-98) already takes `reverseTransitionDuration` from the theme's page-transitions builder, independently of `transitionDuration`; on Android the app's default builder runs 450 ms, so Back from the reopened screen is 150 ms quicker than every other Back. Fix: delete the `reverseTransitionDuration` override (:31-32) and nothing else. Keep the `transitionDuration => Duration.zero` override. Update the class doc comment (:23-24) to: «A page that opens with no slide, as if the app had opened on it; closing it plays the theme's usual Back transition.» Don't add a PageTransitionsTheme, and don't change how sign-up or sign-in push the screen (plain MaterialPageRoute, :236).

UX-1215 to UX-1218: no code change. The workflow didn't read the round-2 reviewer's statuses (written as «**UX-1215 · fixed**»), so they are re-confirmed here. Confirm they are still in the tree and their tests pass: UX-1215, `verifyEmailWrongPassword` in all three ARB files and `_showWrongPassword` with no counter (App/lib/screens/verify_email_screen.dart:350-361), errorMaxLines 12 (:573-576), tests App/test/email_verification_test.dart:1919, :1957, :1985; UX-1216, `resume()`/`load()` return `({String email, DateTime sentAt})` (App/lib/services/pending_verification.dart:61-68) and `initState` counts `max(0, 60 − elapsed)` (verify_email_screen.dart:110-116), tests :2013 and :2037; UX-1217, memoised `load()` read in `MyApp.initState` (App/lib/main.dart:94-95) and held on SessionLoadingScreen while signed out (:391-398), test :2054; UX-1218, `forget()` on any different account signing in (main.dart:371-375), `confirmed()` gone, test :2118. If one doesn't hold, stop and say so rather than re-fixing it.

Don't touch: copy (no ARB change, so no gen-l10n), what the screen asks and sends, the 30-minute life, Backend/. Tests this change rightly breaks: none known; the test at email_verification_test.dart:2054 checks only `transitionDuration`. Reviewer: write each finding's status as a table row (| ID | status | evidence |), as in verify-b2-r1-D.md.
acceptance: ES, cold start on the same storage with a pending address and no session: on «Confirma tu correo», the route's `transitionDuration` is Duration.zero and its `reverseTransitionDuration` equals that of a plain MaterialPageRoute pushed from the same navigator (default test platform). login_screen.dart has no `reverseTransitionDuration` override.
ES, same start: Back from «Confirma tu correo» returns to «Inicia sesión», and the route stays mounted for a non-zero time after the pop (the reverse transition runs) before it is removed.
deviceChecks: Phone: reopen «Confirma tu correo» after a restart (as in P149's check), then press Back or swipe back: it closes with the same animation as Back from any other screen.

Already recorded in round 2 (P149): with «No mantener actividades», come back from Gmail: «Confirma tu correo» shows without «Inicia sesión» sliding away first, and «Reenviar código» is on if more than a minute has passed.
